items.description: On the Impact Dashboard, click 'View source' on the Litter Removed card.
items.expected_result: Lands on the Master Activity Log with ?metric=litter; only logs with litter_general or litter_recyclable metrics show; a green total header reads 'Litter — N bags' matching the card total.

items.description: Click 'View source' on the Participation card.
items.expected_result: Lands on ?metric=participants; only logs with participant_count > 0 appear; header reads 'Participation — N people' matching the card.

items.description: On the Re-Planting card, click a species row (e.g. Restio).
items.expected_result: Lands on ?metric=plant&species=<label>; only logs with that EXACT species label appear (substring variants excluded); header total equals the species row count.

items.description: Click 'View source' on the Invasives Removed card (when no weed data exists).
items.expected_result: List shows the 'No logs found' empty state and header reads 'Weeds — 0' (no crash).

items.description: On the Master Activity Log, try all four sort options: Newest, Oldest, Section A–Z, Participants high→low.
items.expected_result: Each reorders correctly; Section A–Z sorts by section name with the no-section log LAST; Participants high→low puts highest participant_count first.

items.description: On the log list, set metric=litter plus a date range, then click Export.
items.expected_result: Downloads a .xlsx with one row per matching log and columns Date, Section, Task, Task Type, Participants, General Bags, Recyclable Bags, Plants, Weeds, Notes; row count matches the filtered list.

items.description: For each of the 4 cards, drill down with no date filter applied.
items.expected_result: The total header equals the dashboard card number exactly.

items.description: On the litter drill-down, add a Section filter and a Start Date.
items.expected_result: The list and the total header both narrow to the filtered subset.
No crash; behaves like an unfiltered list (unknown metric ignored).
